verdict.rationale: PlanetScale documents read replicas (Postgres and Vitess read-only regions), branch switchovers with list/show by ID, scheduled/manual backups, and backup success/failure webhook events, covering the core reliability and failover lifecycle. Community evidence (comm-1, comm-2) corroborates responsive incident handling, though it's not a rigorous documented failover SLA or independent chaos-test report. Missing for 10: an explicit HA/failover SLA or uptime guarantee, and independent verification of automatic failover behavior under real outages.
